svg.title: Aliasing of a periodic load
svg.desc: A 1.1 hertz load seen once per second appears as a 0.1 hertz wobble of a few percent.
svg.text: A 1.1 Hz load, read once a second
true load, interval mean (raw reading) and displayed CPU
where it lands after sampling at 1 Hz
Displayed wobble after settling: 5.2 points peak to peak with a period of 10 s, from a load that swings 80 points peak to peak.
Nothing in the number says it is not a slow, real fluctuation: a counter delta cannot tell a 0.1 Hz load from a 1.1 Hz one.
